phase_note: no backtest, no implementation, no parameter search, no asset or timeframe sweep

rejection_reasons.OPP-0002: REPLICATE_P1: thousands of events but the direction is negative; a long/cash runtime can only avoid, which is not an edge without a base strategy
rejection_reasons.OPP-0003: WATCH: on-chain labelled flow data is commercial, and a 1-2h effect faces the 23.791 bps cost floor
rejection_reasons.OPP-0004: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: venues throttle their own public liquidation feeds (S-13); rare events; overlaps the closed volatility-spike family
rejection_reasons.OPP-0005: REJECT: best-evidenced source, but the object is a 10-second boundary return far below the cost floor and its 4-12h channel is order flow, already COST_KILLED internally
rejection_reasons.OPP-0006: REJECT: about 0.58 bps per minute gross against a 23.791 bps round trip
rejection_reasons.OPP-0007: REJECT: closed internal family (A-01..A-06 COST_KILLED, gross +0.03..+0.61 bps)
rejection_reasons.OPP-0008: REJECT: needs perpetual shorts, two-venue collateral and 25M-50M USD minimum capital by the project's own prior review
rejection_reasons.OPP-0009: REJECT: about 7 bps for a mined hour-of-day window; below cost and multiple testing

selected_opportunity.title: Spot-BTC ETF net-flow continuation (structural creation demand)
selected_opportunity.why_this_one: the only registered opportunity satisfying every clause of the minimum-evidence filter and the only one that is simultaneously not a closed internal family, expressible in a long/cash spot runtime, and larger per trade than the 23.791 bps cost floor

primary_source.title: Spot ETF Flows & Bitcoin Price Trajectory (preliminary statistical investigation)
primary_source.author: David Lawant (FalconX Research)

supporting_evidence: S-02 peer-reviewed price discovery in Bitcoin ETF market
S-04 peer-reviewed ETF introduction effect on returns and volatility
what_exactly_is_claimed: previous-day ETF net inflow coefficient 0.027 on today's BTC return; Granger p=0.00406 (F=8.4767); flow persistence 0.533; orthogonalised impulse response non-negative, peaking near +1.2% around days 3-4
counter_evidence: S-01: feedback loop from price to flows
S-01: 10-month publication sample, stationarity assumed, non-linearity possible
23.791 bps round trip is a large share of a 1.2% shock response
flows publish after the US close, so the tradable part is the residual
buy-side research, no peer review, no cost model
ambiguities: no entry/exit rule, threshold, lookback, aggregation or sizing is defined by any source
per-day PIT publication timestamp is vendor-specific and must be pinned
level vs change vs normalised difference vs sign is unsettled
replication_risks: POWER: about 21 months of ETF history, few independent shocks; RFC-036 may end INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE
REVERSE_CAUSALITY: flows may follow price, so the residual predictive part must be separated
PIT_FIDELITY: one fixed publication timestamp per day
RULE_INVENTION: the rules are ours and must be frozen and hashed before any measurement
COST_REALISM: the claim must survive 23.791 bps net

independent_verification.note: written independently of the registry builder; sets the authority for PASS/FAIL and FALSE_SUCCESS
independent_verification.limitation_detail: S-02 and S-04 returned HTTP 403 (paywall/bot-block) during the URL audit; reachability 13/20

limitations: no forward or live evidence exists for any registered opportunity; the registry contains none by construction
several sources could only be read at abstract/snippet level (paywalled or bot-blocked hosts); this is declared per source
this RFC cannot and does not establish that OPP-0001 is profitable
